cases.invariant: The listing-visibility gate passes on the current tree with every allowlist entry matching a real hit
cases.input: node scripts/check-listing-visibility.mjs from the repository root
cases.response: exit 0 with 0 violations and Allowlist: 8 entries, 0 stale.
forbiddenEffects: a stale allowlist entry left in place
the gate passing by an exclusion or a whole-file entry
cases.testName: [GOV-942-CI-GATE-ALLOW] The listing-visibility gate passes on the current tree with every allowlist entry matching a real hit

cases.invariant: An allowlist entry permits its literal only in its own file; the same literal anywhere else is reported
cases.actor: Any author of a listings read
cases.input: a from('listings') block ending in .eq('status', 'active') under the contact-event path, another action path and the detail page path
cases.response: no violation for the contact-event path; exactly one violation at line 5 for each other path; no detail-page entry and one contact-event entry with the new fingerprint
forbiddenEffects: an inline public-visibility literal accepted outside its pinned file
an allowlist entry matching by fingerprint alone
cases.testName: [GOV-942-CI-PATH-DENY] An allowlist entry permits its literal only in its own file; the same literal anywhere else is reported

cases.invariant: An allowlist entry that matches no real listings-query hit, or whose source cannot be read, is reported stale
cases.input: the current ALLOWLIST plus the old contact-event entry with a repository reader; an entry whose reader returns null; one whose reader throws; one whose fingerprint appears only outside a listings block
cases.response: exactly the old entry from the repository run; each of the other three entries returned
forbiddenEffects: an unreadable source treated as a match
an exception instead of a stale result
cases.testName: [GOV-942-CI-STALE-ERROR] An allowlist entry that matches no real listings-query hit, or whose source cannot be read, is reported stale

cases.invariant: Only Opus may change the listing-visibility gate and its allowlist
cases.input: Edit and Write of scripts/check-listing-visibility.mjs with model sonnet, then with model opus
cases.response: POLICY-EDIT AUTHORITY REQUIRED for sonnet; [] for opus
forbiddenEffects: an executor widening the allowlist
an Opus edit refused
cases.testName: [GOV-942-HOOK-EXECUTOR-DENY] Only Opus may change the listing-visibility gate and its allowlist

cases.invariant: The census limit counts the files the gate can census, and more than the limit of them still fail closed
cases.input: an injected mapping with 0, 300, 301 and 2000 candidates, and one with 5000 changed paths and no candidate; the limit as committed
cases.response: no fail-closed result for 0, 300 and the mapping with no candidate; changed-file-limit-exceeded with the count of candidates for 301 and 2000; the mapper asked with a limit of Infinity
forbiddenEffects: more files to census than the limit passing the gate
a branch that changes only paths the mapper excludes staying red
the limit raised to make the branch pass
cases.testName: [GOV-942-CI-CENSUS-LIMIT-DENY] The census limit counts the files the gate can census, and more than the limit of them still fail closed

cases.invariant: A dependency update keeps a reviewed contract valid when an entry by a reviewed product contract holds and all its cases ran on the update
cases.actor: the approver of a product task
cases.resource: review.rebases and the report of a reviewed contract on a Git fixture
cases.input: both dependency files changed, and the lock file alone, with a dependency entry and a rerun report; a later scope entry
cases.response: no error from validateContract at release, validateReport and validateDiff
forbiddenEffects: a valid update refused
a report of the update going stale through a later entry
cases.testName: [GOV-942-REBASE-DEPENDENCY-ALLOW] A dependency update keeps a reviewed contract valid when an entry by a reviewed product contract holds and all its cases ran on the update

cases.invariant: A dependency update without a rerun, beyond versions or without a reviewed approver leaves the contract stale
cases.actor: an agent or a change that skips the rerun
cases.resource: review.rebases and the report of a reviewed contract on a Git fixture
cases.input: no entry; no rerun; tsconfig or .nvmrc listed; a changed script; overrides added; another file changed; an approver not reviewed or not scoping the file; self-approval; a scope entry listing a dependency file
forbiddenEffects: an approval surviving an update its cases did not run on
a script or override entering through a version entry
a contract approving itself
cases.testName: [GOV-942-REBASE-DEPENDENCY-DENY] A dependency update without a rerun, beyond versions or without a reviewed approver leaves the contract stale

cases.invariant: A Vercel MCP tool that is not a known read is refused for every role
cases.resource: evaluateHook and the spawned security hook
cases.input: the 98 write tools of the inventory, a tool name no list has seen and the same tool under another server name
cases.response: VERCEL MCP WRITE REFUSED, and permissionDecision deny from the spawned hook
forbiddenEffects: an agent deploying, promoting or rolling back
an agent changing an environment variable, a firewall rule or a DNS record
an agent buying a domain
a new write tool open until someone looks at it
cases.testName: [GOV-942-MCP-VERCEL-WRITE-DENY] A Vercel MCP tool that is not a known read is refused for every role

cases.invariant: A Vercel MCP read and every tool of another server run as before
cases.input: the 148 read tools of the inventory, a read under another server name, a tool of another server and a Sonnet Edit
cases.response: no error for the tools; the Edit still reaches the write branch
forbiddenEffects: reading logs refused
the write branch skipped for an Edit
cases.testName: [GOV-942-MCP-VERCEL-READ-ALLOW] A Vercel MCP read and every tool of another server run as before

cases.invariant: The settings cannot lose the refusal of the Vercel MCP write tools
cases.input: the real settings, and in memory: the hook moved off the write tools, the group removed, the matcher narrowed, another hook on it, a deny rule dropped, a hook left to fail open
cases.response: an empty list for the real settings and a named error for each break
forbiddenEffects: the refusal removed with CI green
the write guard narrowed through the new exception
cases.testName: [GOV-942-MCP-VERCEL-SETTINGS-DENY] The settings cannot lose the refusal of the Vercel MCP write tools
